description: Diffs the machine's listening TCP and UDP sockets each pass and files new listeners, flagging wildcard or low-port listeners as exposed.
name: port_watch

signals.description: A new listening socket bound to a wildcard address, or to a port below 1024, appeared since the learned baseline.
signals.name: exposed_listener

signals.description: A listening socket appeared that was not in the learned baseline, on a non-wildcard address and a port at or above 1024.
signals.name: new_listener
